# telnyx_sim_card_orders (Data Source)

Lists sim card orders, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_sim_card_order`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_address_administrative_area` (String) Filter by state or province where the address is located.
- `filter_address_country_code` (String) Filter by the mobile operator two-character (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) origin country code.
- `filter_address_extended_address` (String) Returns entries with matching name of the supplemental field for address information.
- `filter_address_id` (String) Uniquely identifies the address for the order.
- `filter_address_locality` (String) Filter by the name of the city where the address is located.
- `filter_address_postal_code` (String) Filter by postal code for the address.
- `filter_address_street_address` (String) Returns entries with matching name of the street where the address is located.
- `filter_cost_amount` (String) The total monetary amount of the order.
- `filter_cost_currency` (String) Filter by ISO 4217 currency string.
- `filter_created_at` (String) Filter by ISO 8601 formatted date-time string matching resource creation date-time.
- `filter_quantity` (Number) Filter orders by how many SIM cards were ordered.
- `filter_updated_at` (String) Filter by ISO 8601 formatted date-time string matching resource last update date-time.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `sim_card_orders` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_orders))

<a id="nestedatt--sim_card_orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sim_card_orders`

Read-Only:

- `cost` (Attributes) An object representing the total cost of the order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_orders--cost))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was last created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `order_address` (Attributes) An object representing the address information from when the order was submitted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sim_card_orders--order_address))
- `quantity` (Number) The amount of SIM cards requested in the SIM card order.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) The current status of the SIM Card order.<ul> <li><code>pending</code> - the order is waiting to be processed.</li> <li><code>processing</code> - the order is currently being processed.</li> <li><code>ready_to_ship</code> - the order is ready to be shipped to the specified <b>address</b>.</li> <li><code>shipped</code> - the order was shipped and is on its way to be delivered to the specified <b>address</b>.</li> <li><code>delivered</code> - the order was delivered to the specified <b>address</b>.</li> <li><code>canceled</code> - the order was canceled.</li> </ul>
- `tracking_url` (String) The URL used to get tracking information about the order.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--sim_card_orders--cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sim_card_orders.cost`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) A string representing the cost amount.
- `currency` (String) Filter by ISO 4217 currency string.


<a id="nestedatt--sim_card_orders--order_address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sim_card_orders.order_address`

Read-Only:

- `administrative_area` (String) State or province where the address is located.
- `business_name` (String) The name of the business where the address is located.
- `country_code` (String) The mobile operator two-character (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) origin country code.
- `extended_address` (String) Supplemental field for address information.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the shipping recipient.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the address for the order.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the shipping recipient.
- `locality` (String) The name of the city where the address is located.
- `postal_code` (String) Postal code for the address.
- `street_address` (String) The name of the street where the address is located.
